trigger: The 100 MHz FPGA image produced no visible RT-Thread MSH prompt at the intended 115200 baud setting.
root_cause: Firmware was generated with SOCRV_SOC_CLOCK_HZ fixed at 250 MHz. uart_init() therefore overwrote the correctly parameterized 100 MHz RTL UART divisor with 2170, producing approximately 46083 baud. The RT-Thread timer tick used the same stale clock contract.

scope.change: Add soc_clock_hz(), reading the implemented SYSCTRL clock-frequency register with generated-contract fallback.
Derive the UART divisor from the implemented SoC clock at runtime.
Derive the RT-Thread timer tick interval from the implemented SoC clock at runtime.

interface_impact: No RTL ports, address-map entries, register layouts, interrupts, or memory interfaces changed.
required_checks: Inspect generated code for a SYSCTRL CLOCK_HZ read and absence of a hard-coded 2170 UART divisor.
Regenerate the 100 MHz FPGA bitstream and report timing and DRC status.
